answer: Coordination Entropy Budget. Each identity receives a fixed budget of validated interactions per epoch, tracked as a zephyr-like flow across the network. Creating a new identity requires solving a delayed verification challenge, and every cross-group message consumes budget that only genuine activity replenishes. The schedule is enforced through an island of trusted clocks that rate-limit registration. Attackers pay a karst-like accumulation of wasted compute and time per Sybil, since fresh identities start with near-zero budget and cannot coordinate until costly challenges mature.
